title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a whole tactical account promises an outcome against every permitted opponent reply
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. Whole C0 tactical or game-problem account: choose an opening action, distinguish the opponent's permitted replies, prescribe a different own continuation for each, and assert one common outcome. A legal successful single path does not satisfy the claimed guarantee if another permitted reply escapes it. No historical game variant, target board, word gloss or completed reading is claimed.

design.whole_account: A makes an opening that threatens or prepares a goal. If the opponent chooses response X, A makes continuation C; if the opponent chooses response Y, A makes continuation D. Both branches reach the stated goal under one shared rule system. The paragraph's concluding guarantee covers every response that the opening permits, rather than reporting that the opponent happened to cooperate on one path.

owned_scope.target_nomination: Entire already owned f83r P5, .31-44, 62 ZL groups. Separate Q1/Q2 and other paragraphs remain separate; no convenient branch is selected from an embedded note.
owned_scope.exposure: Previously exposed development evidence. Producer used scope summaries and existing proposal mechanisms, without opening a target-body file, board image or evolving author output.
owned_scope.limits: The illustrated lower system is not identified as a board or combat scene. 62 groups is scope, not support for a tactical interpretation. Written action roles, branch conditions and final claim are unbound.

multistep_consequence: The opening fixes one common starting case and a permitted reply set, not a new initial situation in every branch.
The opponent's choice changes which own continuation is applicable; C and D cannot be exchanged merely because both are legal actions somewhere.

Every legal reply must preserve a continuation reaching the promised terminal condition. One uncovered reply or one legal escaping continuation rejects the claimed guarantee even if the illustrative path succeeds.
Changing the opening may change the opponent's reply set and therefore invalidate a formerly sufficient continuation family.
design.observable_difference: A complete target reading claiming a guaranteed outcome must explicitly pay its common start, opponent-dependent alternatives and final goal. The resulting policy must cover the full prospectively fixed reply set. A single move narrative can be legal and successful while this guarantee is false; an independent list of remedies can give fresh starts and omit reply coverage. No target guarantee or complete reply set has been found by this producer.

novelty.difference_from_140: 140 replays one complete actual legal move narrative from a fixed initial board to a final board. It does not require an outcome for every opposing reply or a strategy that selects different continuations after observed opponent choices.
novelty.difference_from_388: 388 binds scholar variants to inherited master starts and includes opponent-dependent continuations and counters. It does not assert that the bounded extract exhausts every permitted reply or force a common winning outcome; its unowned later alternatives remain unfilled. This proposal adds an explicit universal outcome claim, not another reference mark.
novelty.related_not_reopened: 349's transport safety narrative constrains a chosen sequence against passive hazards, not an actively choosing opponent. W91's proof skeleton and known music drafts are separate hypotheses; no sol, qokeey or music meaning is inherited.
novelty.checks: Bounded search game/chess/opponent/strategy/all-replies, compact show140/388, two duplicates queries, route-check game strategy forced win opponent replies, then actual140/388 proposal primaries. Empty strategy search was not treated as absent prior art.

assumptions: This is a whole C0 hypothesis about adversarial choice, not proof that the manuscript contains a game, combat manual or any specific language.

No modern chess rules are silently imported. If a game variant is later chosen, its legal moves and reply set must be fixed independently of convenient target matches; they need not already be confirmed to retain this raw idea.
An account may be tactical prose without a board, but the opponent choice set and goal then require an equally finite written semantic contract.
Actors, common start, branches, times and goal must share explicit references; no fresh unseen starting position or deleted losing branch.
The model must explain known directed composition, spaces, whole residuals and entry context. A free graph of renamed action nodes is insufficient.
why_it_could_fail: The text may report one actual sequence or list alternatives without guaranteeing a goal.
The two named cases may not exhaust the opponent's replies; pretending they do manufactures the guarantee.
Unknown action/rule assignments may permit arbitrary tree construction, leaving a winning-policy account indistinguishable from generic conditional prose.
No already owned written scope may constrain the goal or permissible reply set. That is missing binding/capacity, not proof against every tactical reading.
design.smallest_next_step: If shortlisted, author one complete existing P5 account as a case-split tactic, preserving every group, and compare it with a one-path report using the same actions, references and goal. Before any strategy computation, show which written assertions require universal coverage and fix a finite reply set. No new game engine, decoder or historical source intake for raw retention.
design.decision_and_stop: If a paid whole reading has a universal guarantee that a one-path rival does not satisfy, shortlist the genuine different consequence for a fixed exposed-data test. If the supposed guarantee is merely added English or opponent choices are free, park the offer. A missing established board/seedword is a limitation, not a duplicate reason; unchanged consequences justify no implementation.
design.retained_stops: GDT899/908 and numerical/source-prefix routes unchanged; GDT979 fixed code contract not expanded; GDT947 reference failure not repaired; W91 original failed skeleton retained while broader argumentation stays open; GDT913/914/925/928 and original616 decisions unchanged. No reserved confirmation.
design.access: No target-body files, evolving author outputs, new images/source/data, f84/f84r/f116v or reserves, outside contacts, tests, simulations, parser/decoder, route/ledger/state edits or git/publication. Raw idea only.
